Innovate Tomorrow Today

Miami University’s Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence at the College of Engineering and Computing (CEC) is designed to meet the increasing demand for AI professionals across various industries.

Through a pioneering curriculum, students gain a strong foundation in AI concepts, technologies, and applications, while also developing the ability to apply them in diverse contexts. Unlike many programs that take a one-size-fits-all approach, we emphasize personalization: Every student can tailor their learning by selecting an application area that aligns with their interests and career goals including emerging technologies, cybersecurity, quantum computing, or philosophy. This integration of technical expertise with domain-specific application ensures our graduates don’t just understand how AI works—they know how to use it responsibly and innovatively to solve problems across industries.

Visit the Department

AI for Impact: Integrated Curriculum for Future AI Leaders

Core courses in AI, computing and math, combined with courses in an application area selected by the student.

  • CSE 274 Data Abstraction and Data Structures
  • CSE 374 Algorithms I
  • CSE 432 Machine Learning
  • CSE 433 Deep Learning
  • CSE 434 Generative Artificial Intelligence
  • CSE 486 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
Full Course List

Career Options

Unlock diverse opportunities in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence. Graduates of the B.S. in AI program are prepared for careers such as AI Engineer, AI Developer, Data Scientist with AI specialization, Machine Learning Engineer, and AI Researcher. They also bring value as Applied AI Professionals and Technologists across industries like Healthcare, Manufacturing, Finance, and Education, applying AI to solve real-world challenges.

Quick Facts

  • Second Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence in Ohio. One of very few undergraduate programs in the United States.
  • Program emphasizes industry and community engagement, utilizing partnerships with industry, government, and local communities to provide practical experience, hands-on learning, internships, capstone projects, and mentorship opportunities.
  • Student-selected “application area” allows students to tailor their AI skills in alignment with their individual interests and career goals.
  • Program designed to meet the increasing demand for AI professionals at both local and national levels, positioning graduates for high-demand careers in technology across various industries.

Undergraduate Research

The Department of Computer Science and Software Engineering (CSE) offers a strong culture of undergraduate research. Faculty members with externally funded projects actively involve undergraduate students. Many of these projects are centered on AI and its applications—ranging from machine learning and natural language processing to AI in healthcare, education, and cybersecurity. Students in the BS in AI program will have the opportunity to collaborate with faculty on cutting-edge research, gain valuable hands-on experience, and even present their work at conferences or contribute to academic publications. These experiences enhance both their technical skills and professional development.
